remarks:
Welcome to 32 Miller Street, Gowanda, NY! This gorgeous ranch home offers comfortable, easy living with a relaxing atmosphere, combining comfort, convenience, and plenty of storage. The sunroom and breezeway are filled with beautiful natural light, creating a bright and inviting space to enjoy year round. Central air keeps you comfortable through the warmer months, and the attached garage adds everyday convenience.

The expansive attic offers exciting potential to create a second story suite or additional living space with finishing work. The clean, unfinished basement provides even more storage and possibilities to suit your needs.

Recent updates include a new fence in 2025, a water softener installed in early 2025, and a new roof and siding in 2026. With these major updates taken care of, you can focus on settling in and making this home your own!

Outside, you'll find a large, fully fenced backyard with plenty of room to relax, entertain, garden, or simply enjoy the outdoors. A double driveway provides ample parking.

If you're looking for comfortable, low maintenance living with great outdoor space, convenient features, and room to make it your own, this charming ranch is ready for you to move in and enjoy. Don't miss the opportunity to make this home yours!
